# Meteor Dodge

A canvas-based game where the player pilots a ship at the bottom of the screen, shooting falling meteors. Each meteor that hits the ship reduces a health bar; when health reaches zero the player loses. The objective is to survive and score points by destroying meteors.

1: // Simple Meteor Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   canvas.width = 800;
8:   canvas.height = 600;
9:   // Generate simple starfield
10:   const stars = [];
11:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
12:     stars.push({
13:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
14:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
15:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
16:     });
17:   }
18:   // Audio setup
19:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
20:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
21:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
22:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
23:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
24:     osc.type = 'sine';
25:     osc.connect(gain);
26:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
27:     osc.start();
28:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
29:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
30:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
31:   }
32:   function playShoot() { playTone(800, 0.05); }
33:   function playExplosion() { playTone(200, 0.2); }
34:   function playGameOver() { playTone(100, 0.5); }
35: 
36:   // Player ship
37:   const ship = {
38:     w: 40,
39:     h: 20,
40:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
41:     y: canvas.height - 30,
42:     speed: 5,
43:     health: 3,
44:   };
45: 
46:   const bullets = [];
47:   const meteors = [];
48:   let score = 0;
49:   let lastMeteor = 0;
50:   const meteorInterval = 1000; // ms
51:   let gameOver = false;
52: 
53:   const keys = {};
54:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
55:     keys[e.code] = true;
56:     if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
57:   });
58:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
59: 
60:   function spawnMeteor() {
61:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
62:     meteors.push({
63:       x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
64:       y: -size,
65:       w: size,
66:       h: size,
67:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
68:     });
69:   }
70: 
71:   function update(dt) {
72:     // Move ship
73:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] && ship.x > 0) ship.x -= ship.speed;
74:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] && ship.x + ship.w < canvas.width) ship.x += ship.speed;
75:     // Shoot
76:     if (keys['Space']) {
77:       // simple fire rate limit
78: if (!ship.lastShot || Date.now() - ship.lastShot > 250) {
79:           bullets.push({ x: ship.x + ship.w / 2, y: ship.y, w: 4, h: 10, speed: 7 });
80:           ship.lastShot = Date.now();
81:           playShoot();
82:         }
83:     }
84:     // Update bullets
85:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
86:       const b = bullets[i];
87:       b.y -= b.speed;
88:       if (b.y + b.h < 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
89:     }
90:     // Spawn meteors
91:     if (Date.now() - lastMeteor > meteorInterval) {
92:       spawnMeteor();
93:       lastMeteor = Date.now();
94:     }
95:     // Update meteors
96:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
97:       const m = meteors[i];
98:       m.y += m.speed;
99:       if (m.y > canvas.height) {
100:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
101:         continue;
102:       }
103:       // Bullet collision
104:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
105:         const b = bullets[j];
106:         if (b.x < m.x + m.w && b.x + b.w > m.x && b.y < m.y + m.h && b.y + b.h > m.y) {
107:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
108:           meteors.splice(i, 1);
109:           score += 10;
110:           playExplosion();
111:           break;
112:         }
113:       }
114:     }
115:     // Ship collision
116:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
117:       const m = meteors[i];
118:       if (ship.x < m.x + m.w && ship.x + ship.w > m.x && ship.y < m.y + m.h && ship.y + ship.h > m.y) {
119:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
120: ship.health -= 1;
121:           if (ship.health <= 0) {

125:       }
126:     }
127:   }

131:     const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
132:     gradient.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');

147:     // Draw meteors with radial gradient

149:       const radGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(

154:         m.y + m.h / 2,
155:         m.w / 2
156:       );
157:       radGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff8a80');
158:       radGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b71c1c');
159:       ctx.fillStyle = radGrad;
160:       ctx.beginPath();
161:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.w / 2, m.y + m.h / 2, m.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
162:       ctx.fill();
163:     });
164:     // HUD
165:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
166:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
167:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
168:     ctx.fillText(`Health: ${ship.health}`, 10, 40);
169:     if (gameOver) {
170:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
171:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
172:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
173:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
174:       ctx.font = '36px sans-serif';
175:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
176:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
177:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
178:     }
179:   }
180:   }
181: 
182:   let lastTime = 0;
183:   function loop(timestamp) {
184:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
185:     lastTime = timestamp;
186:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);

191: })();
